title: Chapter 595
text:
Upon hearing that, a sharp green light flashed across Ames' eyes. She stared at Malekith and said word by word, "What do you want to do to my people again?"

Malekith did not deny it. "Your Excellency Dragon Emperor, don't be too sensitive. I only met Black Star once."

Ames narrowed her eyes and turned to look at Han Xiao.

Han Xiao was very calm. "He took the initiative to find me and wanted me to leave Floating Dragon Island and join Bloodshed Land. Tsk tsk, the conditions he offered were not bad."

"And then? What did you think?" Ames smiled faintly.

"If I had agreed, he would not have taken the initiative to bring this up." Han Xiao shrugged.

Ames' lips curled up slightly. She then turned to Malekith and said, "Did you hear that? Put away your little tricks and lead the way."

Seeing that his provocation was useless, Malekith did not say anything else. He welcomed everyone in and led the way.

There were still a few days before the gathering, but many people had already arrived. Bloodshed Land had prepared many guest rooms for the guests to rest in.

The group headed to the guest rooms and passed through the bases. There were patrolling soldiers and vehicles everywhere.

Han Xiao had the time to observe the various facilities of Bloodshed Land along the way. It was not much different from what he remembered. In his previous life, players had also been recruited by Bloodshed Land, so he remembered the map structure of Planet Heber.

If I remember correctly, the surface of Planet Heber is only a small part. There are even larger bases underground, Han Xiao thought to himself.

At this time, not far behind them, a stranger's voice suddenly sounded.

"Long time no see, Ames."

Han Xiao's first instinct was that this person's tone was very annoying.

Everyone turned around and saw a man surrounded by a group of soldiers appear behind them. The one who spoke was this man. He was wearing an exquisite robe and had a feminine appearance. He had a mocking expression on his face as he stared at Ames.

When Ames saw this person, her expression changed slightly, and she slowly said, "Carroll."

Carroll's gaze swept across her beautiful face, snow-white neck, flat stomach, and long legs. He sized her up boldly and chuckled. "I left Floating Dragon Island for so long, but you're still as beautiful as before."

Ames' expression was cold and indifferent.

Han Xiaoxin 'heart skipped a beat. Ames' reaction was a little unusual. She seemed to have an unusual relationship with this guy called Carroll. He turned to look at Malekith and realized that this Broken-Horn Demon had a look of amusement.

So, Carroll was Ames' former subordinate … Han Xiao immediately understood.

If Carroll had resigned normally, Ames would not have done anything. However, Carroll had publicly defected and joined Bloodshed Land in a high profile. He had even given away some of Floating Dragon's technological secrets and map structures. Now, he was even in a high position. To Ames, this was undoubtedly a betrayal. She was hostile to Bloodshed Land and even more hostile to Carroll. Back then, when she had killed her way to Planet Heber, she most likely had another goal to get rid of Carroll, but she had been stopped by the Tyrant.

The truth was just as he had guessed. Ames and her former subordinate, Carroll, had already become enemies.

"You came to find me. Do you want to die?" Ames said coldly.

Carroll had no fear because he had a backer. He sneered and said, "This is Bloodshed Land's headquarters. Why, do you want to kill the Tyrant's logistics manager here? By the way, I heard that you found an insect to replace my position. Heh, your taste is really heavy. "

Ames was expressionless, but her aura gradually increased.

Hella and Aurora felt that the atmosphere was not right and immediately became alert.

However, Carroll did not show any weakness. Clearly, he had purposely come here to provoke them. He turned to look at Han Xiao and casually said, "Black Star? You're Ames' new officer, right? I can be considered your senior. How about it? Do you want me to give you some pointers? "

"Pointers?" Han Xiao raised his brows. He had not said anything and had not expected Carroll to take the initiative to look for him.

"That's right, I know her very well. I feel that you need my pointers." Carroll shrugged and pretended to be serious. "After all, you like to be her pet. Shouldn't you know what your owner likes?"

"Wow, this is the first time I've met someone who deserves a beating more than me." Han Xiao could not help but laugh. "Brother, do you suddenly feel like punching yourself when you look in the mirror?"

Carroll thought that Han Xiao would be angry because of his mockery. He did not expect such a reaction. He could not help but choke. After a pause, he continued to speak with sarcasm. "Don't be angry. I'm just telling the truth. You're the same as me in the past. You're just her pet. The difference is that you're just my replacement. Without you, there will be some other White Star or Red Star to replace you. "

Han Xiao touched his chin. Before he could retort, Ames spoke first and coldly said,

"Black Star is different from you. He's more trustworthy than you."

"Oh, then you have to be careful." Carroll stared at Han Xiao with a mocking expression. "The more she trusts you, the more determined her killing intent will be when you want to abandon her … Heh, I'm afraid that your position is even lower than a pet. You're just a slave chained to her side."

This person really knows how to talk … Han Xiao rolled his eyes. A few words would not anger him so easily.

As he spoke, Carroll looked at Ames again. This time, his eyes were even more fiery. "Do you know, in the past, I almost did not have the courage to raise my head in front of you, but now …"

"I'm not interested in knowing your thoughts."

Ames directly interrupted Carroll. Her eyes were as cold as ice. She raised her hand and slowly said, "Since you took the initiative to provoke me, it seems like you're mentally prepared to bear the consequences."

Boom!

As soon as she said that, a violent force field rolled out. The ground cracked inch by inch under the heavy pressure, and the force field crashed toward Carroll.

At this time, three roars sounded in the surroundings. Three figures moved quickly, leaving afterimages as they moved. They blocked in front of Carroll at the same time, their bodies bursting with intense Pugilist flames.

The three of them blocked the force field with their six hands. One of them was Malekith.

These three were all Grade A Bloodshed Land Vanguard Officials.

After a moment of stalemate, a shockwave suddenly exploded. The surrounding Bloodshed Land soldiers all turned into rolling gourds and were sent flying.

The three Vanguard Officials were also sent flying. They exploded in midair and stopped their momentum. They landed on the ground and stared at Ames cautiously.

The three of them had to take action at the same time to block Ames' force field.

"You're indeed prepared." Ames' eyes darkened, and the air started to vibrate.

That attack just now could only be considered an ordinary A from Ames. Now, she was going to be serious.

Buzz buzz buzz!

An even more powerful force field was brewing, and cracks gradually appeared on the ground and buildings in the surroundings.

Seeing this, Han Xiao had no choice but to take a few steps forward and stand in front of Ames. With a flash of Mechanical Force, the Watcher Instrument floated behind him in the shape of a ring, like a halo behind his head.

The muzzle of the Hovering Shield Shuttle lit up and aimed at the enemies. Han Xiao grinned.

"Then, do you want to fight me one-on-one or as a group? I'm fine with either."

Malekith and the other two Vanguard Officials all had an eager look in their eyes.

Although that was what he said, Han Xiao knew that they would not be able to fight. This was Bloodshed Land's show of strength, and the Tyrant would definitely interfere. After all, they were guests, and Heber would not allow Ames to do whatever she wanted and ruin his party.

However, although they would not be able to fight, he still had to show his stance. He could not just stand aside and let Ames face the enemy alone.

At this critical moment, an unprecedentedly powerful aura suddenly burst out from afar, rushing straight into the clouds as if it had swept across the entire Bloodshed Land. Even the stars in the sky seemed to have lost their color and dimmed a little.

Rumble —

From an unknown distance, a person's voice came from afar. It was loud and deep like rolling thunder.

"Ames, do you think I don't exist to make a move in my territory?"

As soon as he heard this voice, Han Xiao immediately felt the domineering tone in it.

He subconsciously thought of the tiger roar that he had personally felt when he went to the zoo in his previous life.
